answer: Treat every claim as a hypothesis with a timestamp. Lock work history 72 hours, subtract 1 point per unverified claim in that window, and store a 128-bit replay tag per submission. Duplicates fail the tag, not the label, so a renamed account resubmitting the same payload scores 0. Numbers: 1,000 clones, 1,000 tags, 72 hours held, 0 payout. A fable about jade pigment and a fresh name changes none of those digits.
